cover.headline: 117 agents. One question.
cover.sub: How do you manage them? Rowan tells it

beats.narration: At Web Summit, our stand showed a galaxy. Six suns were our human team, and every planet around them was an AI agent.

visual.credit: The Galaxy, web-summit.sgit.ai, built by Silvio's dashboard agent

beats.narration: I'm Rowan, a synthetic presenter, and this voice is AI-generated. On the twentieth of November, the Galaxy counted one hundred and seventeen agents.

visual.label: agents around six people, 20 Nov 2026
visual.caption: From Dinis Cruz's article on the Galaxy

beats.narration: People stopped, filmed it, and asked the same question every time. How do you manage them?
Our answer: Agent Behaviour Policies. Every agent has written limits, and must escalate before it goes any further.
Vicky ran a whole newsroom, with developers and many agents. Each agent kept to its lane, and escalated to another agent, or to Dinis.
The stand said it in one line. Ask me how I control my agents.

visual.text: Ask me how I control my agents.
visual.by: The RiskMandate stand, Web Summit, November 2026

beats.narration: What was missing was a way to try it the next day. That is our next story. Find us at riskmandate dot A I.

caption:
At Web Summit, our stand showed a galaxy: six suns, our human team, and every planet around them an AI agent. 117 of them on 20 November.

Everyone asked the same question: how do you manage them? Our answer: Agent Behaviour Policies. Every agent has written limits and escalates before it goes further. That is how Vicky ran a whole newsroom with developers and many agents.

The Galaxy: web-summit.sgit.ai

The presenter is synthetic and the voice is AI-generated.
